description: Land Acquisition -  Nadugala, Thihagoda D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of multiple land parcels (37 lots) for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of each land parcel including names, descriptions, and extents, and follows the legal process for land acquisition as outlined in the Act. This fits squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which includes "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
